request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve, with a total withdrawal of 540,750 ADA after a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Dolos is a lightweight Cardano data node built in Rust that provides access to chain data without the overhead of traditional full nodes.

Dolos connects directly to the Cardano network, indexes the full breadth of ledger primitives, and exposes five query interfaces including Mini-Blockfrost, UTxO-RPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C unix socket.
The Dolos repository has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.

The maintainer work will cover dependency updates, Cardano protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, documentation, issue triage, contribution review, community communication, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested amount does not, at the time of submission, breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Audit and oversight costs are included in the proposal overhead, with Intersect and technically capable third parties providing reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Treasury funds will be administered through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts using a Treasury Reserve Smart Contract, a Project-Specific Smart Contract, defined multisig-like authorization roles, an Oversight Committee, and a public dashboard for auditing.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for a 12-month Dolos maintenance grant administered by Intersect through smart-contract treasury tooling, with stated maintenance, community support, AI-documentation, oversight, and prior-process justifications.
